nbf50c6d8a41.s: Which of the following pairs (State – Chief Minister after the 2026 Assembly elections) is correctly matched?
nbf50c6d8a41.x: V.D. Satheesan (Congress, UDF) became Chief Minister of Kerala. Himanta Biswa Sarma is the Assam CM, C. Joseph Vijay the Tamil Nadu CM and Suvendu Adhikari the West Bengal CM.

n9f1661207f0.s: Who became the first BJP Chief Minister of West Bengal after the May 2026 Assembly election?
n9f1661207f0.x: The BJP won 208 seats in West Bengal and Suvendu Adhikari was sworn in on 9 May 2026 as the State's first BJP Chief Minister.

n6625fd990a7.s: In the 2026 Assam Assembly election, the NDA won how many of the 126 seats?
n6625fd990a7.x: The NDA won 102 of 126 seats (BJP 82) and Himanta Biswa Sarma began a second term as Chief Minister.

cab2bd5114fd2a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Women and Men in India report was first published in 2005.
2. Gender parity has been achieved from the primary to the higher secondary level.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab2bd5114fd2a.x: Statement 1 is wrong: the report was first published in 1995. Statement 2 is correct.

ca089d26a1fbe4.s: The Women and Men in India 2025 report, released by MoSPI at Bhubaneswar, was its:
ca089d26a1fbe4.x: MoSPI released the Women and Men in India 2025 report at Bhubaneswar as its 27th edition.

cab93dcb0181c6.s: Which team won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 by defeating New Zealand by 96 runs?
cab93dcb0181c6.x: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, beating runner-up New Zealand by 96 runs.

ca8be0b753ac2a.s: Which of the following about the IPL 2026 individual awards is NOT correct?
o: Vaibhav Suryavanshi won the Orange Cap with 776 runs.
Vaibhav Suryavanshi won the Purple Cap.
Kagiso Rabada won the Purple Cap with 29 wickets.
Vaibhav Suryavanshi became the youngest ever Orange Cap winner.
ca8be0b753ac2a.x: Suryavanshi won the Orange Cap (776 runs, youngest ever winner); the Purple Cap went to Kagiso Rabada with 29 wickets.

n14e334d44c0.s: The IPL 2026 final was played on 31 May 2026 at:
n14e334d44c0.x: The IPL 2026 final was held on 31 May 2026 at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad.

ca5feb5cb5d14e.s:
Consider the following statements about the Indian Premier League:
1. The IPL started in 2008.
2. Rajasthan Royals were the first champions.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5feb5cb5d14e.x: Both are correct: the IPL began in 2008 and Rajasthan Royals won the first title.

ca0851059d6162.s: Which of the following pairs regarding IPL records is correctly matched?
o: David Warner – 973 runs in a season
Virat Kohli – 973 runs in a season
ca0851059d6162.x: Virat Kohli holds the record of 973 runs in a season. Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings have 5 titles each, and David Warner has 3 Orange Caps.

n3cf87debc5b.s: Which country ranked first in the World Press Freedom Index 2026?
n3cf87debc5b.x: Norway topped the 2026 index published by Reporters Without Borders, which reported global press freedom at a 25-year low.

nb2914bce713.s: The Union Government dismissed the Press Freedom rankings, in which India fared poorly, as:
nb2914bce713.x: The government dismissed the Press Freedom rankings as biased.

n0e17351cfdf.s:
Consider the following posts in Andhra Pradesh and their holders:
1. Lokayukta – Justice Lisa Gill
2. Director General of Police – Harish Kumar Gupta
3. Chief Secretary – G. Sai Prasad
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
n0e17351cfdf.x: Harish Kumar Gupta is DGP and G. Sai Prasad is Chief Secretary. The Lokayukta is Justice T. Mallikarjuna Rao; Justice Lisa Gill is Chief Justice of the AP High Court.

nd4392094a65.s: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva provides cashless care to 1.43 crore families covering how many procedures?
nd4392094a65.x: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva covers 3,257 procedures for 1.43 crore families.

nc830e3d3c5a.s: ICRISAT was established at Hyderabad in 1972 with assistance from:
nc830e3d3c5a.x: ICRISAT was set up at Hyderabad in 1972 with help from the United Nations.

n0f8354ca603.s: According to the 16th Finance Commission, which State has the highest per-capita pension spending?
n0f8354ca603.x: The 16th Finance Commission found Andhra Pradesh to have the highest per-capita pension spending among States.

n72464a6fc6b.s: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva, administered by the Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust, provides cashless care mainly to:
n72464a6fc6b.x: The scheme gives cashless care to BPL families; APL families, employees and journalists have separate schemes under the trust.

n4db6e83cda8.s: Vidya Shakti, which provides STEM coaching for Classes 3–12, is implemented in collaboration with:
n4db6e83cda8.x: Vidya Shakti is run in collaboration with IIT Madras.

nc4b4e4b3893.s: The opposition argued that the ₹2.5 lakh insurance plan posed a threat to which scheme?
nc4b4e4b3893.x: The opposition said the ₹2.5 lakh insurance plan threatened Aarogyasri.

nc78d8a28e82.s: Which of the following AP platform – purpose pairs is correctly matched?
nc78d8a28e82.x: AWARE is the predictive-governance tool. RTGS is the real-time monitoring hub, Meekosam the grievance portal and Mana Mitra the WhatsApp-based service.

n049f386df91.s: e-Pragati, to which 45 more services were added in February 2026, is Andhra Pradesh's:
n049f386df91.x: e-Pragati is the State's unified service portal.

nfae77a158db.s: As Andhra Pradesh's 13 Zilla Praja Parishads become 28, which elections are due?
nfae77a158db.x: ZP and MPTC polls are due in the context of the increase from 13 ZPPs to 28.

n5d9a5fef4ae.s: The "new welfarism" critique argues that direct cash transfers may:
o: Raise the State's own tax revenue
Crowd out public goods and strain State finances
Reduce the number of welfare beneficiaries
n5d9a5fef4ae.x: The critique holds that direct cash transfers can crowd out public goods and pressure State finances.

nc20172de3d2.s:
The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet constituted task forces in 2026 on which of the following?
1. Social-media abuse
2. Godavari pollution
3. Land disputes
nc20172de3d2.x: Task forces were set up on social-media abuse (July 2026) and Godavari pollution (May 2026); land disputes went to fast-track special courts.

nafadbf18d95.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Sri City International University – Tirupati
2. Chalapathi University – Guntur
3. Private women's university – established in July 2026
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
nafadbf18d95.x: All three are correct: Sri City International University is at Tirupati, Chalapathi University at Guntur, and a private women's university was set up in July 2026.

n3237174253d.s: Critics of Andhra Pradesh's fiscal position cited debt of about what share of GSDP, along with heavy guarantees and off-budget loans?
n3237174253d.x: The criticism centred on debt of about 36% of GSDP, heavy guarantees and off-budget loans.

nd2ac04a69a0.s: Over 23 months, how many projects worth ₹21.64 lakh crore were reported in Andhra Pradesh?
nd2ac04a69a0.x: A total of 756 projects worth ₹21.64 lakh crore were reported over 23 months.

n6b0accdba64.s: Which of the following fishing harbour – district pairs is correctly matched?
n6b0accdba64.x: Nizampatnam is in Bapatla. Juvvaladinne is in Nellore, Machilipatnam in Krishna and Uppada in Kakinada.

n153ce0bee75.s: The proposed Visakhapatnam metro, with four corridors and an estimated cost of about ₹28,000 crore, covers:
n153ce0bee75.x: The Visakhapatnam metro proposal has four corridors over 76.70 km costing about ₹28,000 crore.

n1ee3d39b331.s: Which of the following institution – location pairs in Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
n1ee3d39b331.x: NIT is at Tadepalligudem. AIIMS is at Mangalagiri, IIT at Tirupati and IIM at Visakhapatnam.

n8854dfa17f9.s:
Consider the following State symbols of residual Andhra Pradesh:
1. Rose-ringed Parakeet – State bird
2. Jasmine – State flower
3. Blackbuck – State animal
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
n8854dfa17f9.x: All three are correct; the Rose-ringed Parakeet, Jasmine and Blackbuck (with Neem as State tree) are the symbols of residual AP.

n31f6736dbbd.s: Which athlete from Andhra Pradesh (Visakhapatnam) received the Arjuna Award 2024 for athletics?
n31f6736dbbd.x: Jyothi Yarraji of Visakhapatnam received the Arjuna Award 2024 for athletics; Jeevanji Deepthi on the same list is from Telangana.

n82dddb9dc7e.s: Which of the following is NOT a Telugu Jnanpith Award winner?
n82dddb9dc7e.x: Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy is associated with Telugu Language Day, not the Jnanpith; the other three are Telugu Jnanpith winners.

n5777b5186a3.s: The One District One Product (ODOP) initiative is implemented by ____ in association with the States.
n5777b5186a3.x: ODOP is run by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) with the States.

n675d86b11f5.s: In 2022, G. Satya Prabhakar Rao became Additional District & Sessions Judge of which district?
n675d86b11f5.x: G. Satya Prabhakar Rao became Additional District & Sessions Judge, Chittoor in 2022.

nebea0aaafb3.s:
Dhimsa is performed by which of the following communities?
1. Bagata
2. Valmiki
3. Gadaba
nebea0aaafb3.x: Dhimsa is performed by the Bagata, Valmiki, Gadaba and Konda Dora communities.

n081c5495b2d.s: Which of the following festival – venue pairs is correctly matched?
n081c5495b2d.x: The Gandikota Festival is held at Jammalamadugu, Kadapa. Visakha Utsav is at Visakhapatnam, the Flamingo Festival at Sullurpeta/Nelapattu and the Kondapalli Toys Festival at Kondapalli.

n63d39752346.s:
Consider the following statements on the Republic Day tableau awards:
1. Andhra Pradesh's 2025 tableau depicted Etikoppaka toys.
2. The Andhra Pradesh tableau placed third.
3. Tripura's Kharchi Puja tableau placed second.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n63d39752346.x: All three are correct: AP's Etikoppaka toys tableau placed third and Tripura's Kharchi Puja tableau placed second.

n2214870be75.s: Which of the following person – post pairs is correctly matched?
n2214870be75.x: S. Bharani is SAAP Vice-Chairman & MD. A. Ravi Naidu is SAAP Chairman and Mandipalli Ramprasad Reddy is the Sports Minister.

n88cd6cedcf9.s: Valluri Ajaya Babu of Vizianagaram won silver at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games in which weightlifting category?
n88cd6cedcf9.x: Valluri Ajaya Babu won the silver medal in the 79 kg category at Glasgow 2026.

n965f71f8d54.s: Chess player Koneru Humpy is a two-time World ____ champion.
n965f71f8d54.x: Koneru Humpy is a two-time World Rapid chess champion.

n2670a5bcace.s: Which is the State tree of residual Andhra Pradesh?
n2670a5bcace.x: Neem is the State tree of residual AP; Red Sanders is endemic to Seshachalam but is not the State tree, and Jammi Chettu is Telangana's.

nee3b16a853b.s: Which of the following minister – portfolio pairs is correctly matched?
o: K. Atchannaidu – Tourism, Culture and Cinematography
Kandula Durgesh – Municipal Administration and Urban Development
nee3b16a853b.x: Nimmala Ramanaidu holds Water Resources. Narayana holds Municipal Administration, Atchannaidu Agriculture and Fisheries, and Durgesh Tourism, Culture and Cinematography.

n0e78329f56b.s: Registered Unrecognised Political Parties (RUPPs), which get tax exemption under Section 12 of the Income Tax Act, 2025, can have how many star campaigners?
n0e78329f56b.x: RUPPs were noted as having 20 star campaigners, with tax exemption under Section 12 of the Income Tax Act, 2025.

nef8dd733052.s: The MMDR Amendment, 2026 of the Ministry of Mines establishes a fiscal regime for:
nef8dd733052.x: The MMDR Amendment, 2026 sets up a fiscal regime for critical minerals under the Ministry of Mines.

n2ed311eeba8.s: The Punjab and Haryana High Court struck down Haryana's policy reserving what share of private-sector jobs for local residents?
n2ed311eeba8.x: The High Court struck down Haryana's 75% reservation of private-sector jobs for locals.

n75d0efb2250.s: Which city was made the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh by Parliament?
n75d0efb2250.x: Parliament made Amaravati the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh.

nc9598f0d94f.s: In August 2026, Nauru was renamed as:
nc9598f0d94f.x: Nauru was renamed the Republic of Naoero in August 2026.

nba350199a98.s: Bihar's proposed 85% reservation in 2025 led to debate over the reservation ceiling of:
nba350199a98.x: Bihar's 85% reservation proposal raised the question of the 50% ceiling on reservations.

n675e3cc78f0.s: The RBI issues banknotes under which Section of the RBI Act?
n675e3cc78f0.x: Banknotes are issued by the RBI under Section 22 of the RBI Act, while coins are issued by the Government of India under the Coinage Act, 2011.

n675252be5e1.s: The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) loan for Andhra Pradesh is associated with:
n675252be5e1.x: The VCIC loan is from the ADB, while the SALT loan is from the World Bank.

nd9acec7b0c2.s: A change relating to UPI MDR was expected to take effect from:
nd9acec7b0c2.x: A UPI MDR change was expected from 15 October 2026, with an October 2026 rate hike also considered likely.

nc48ce196111.s: The rise in CPI inflation to 4.45% after the Q1 FY27 GDP rebasing was linked mainly to:
o: Higher oil prices linked to the West Asia situation
nc48ce196111.x: The rise in CPI to 4.45% was associated with West Asia-related oil-price pressures.

nff3bdc38bcd.s: Under the Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses, 100% MSP procurement for four years covers:
nff3bdc38bcd.x: The mission provides 100% MSP procurement of tur, urad and masoor for four years.

nfc15663d31b.s: The Noida International Airport at Jewar, described as a net-zero airport, is being developed as a:
nfc15663d31b.x: Jewar airport is a public-private partnership and net-zero airport; its Phase 1 was opened by the Prime Minister.

n12b25bbd7b9.s: Skill India certificates are mapped to NSQF and linked to:
n12b25bbd7b9.x: Skill India certificates are mapped to the National Skills Qualification Framework and linked to DigiLocker.

n2a3f6e532dc.s: Which of the following pairs (arrangement – purpose) is correctly matched?
o: AP Government–Kia India – Aeronautics skilling centre at NSTI Kanpur
n2a3f6e532dc.x: FIU-IND and SEBI cooperate on anti-money laundering; FIU-IND–I4C targets cyber-financial fraud, India–France concerns NSTI Kanpur and Kia India the Penukonda ITI.

n00aba6e823e.s: Which is India's first major river-linking project, facing protests over displacement?
n00aba6e823e.x: Ken-Betwa is India's first major river-linking project and has faced displacement protests.

n0d6ea7bd01b.s:
Consider the following statements about Project BHISHM:
1. It consists of portable cubes that function as mobile hospitals.
2. It comes under the Aarogya Maitri initiative.
3. Two such cubes were provided to Sri Lanka.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n0d6ea7bd01b.x: All three are correct: BHISHM, under Aarogya Maitri, provides portable mobile-hospital cubes, two of which went to Sri Lanka.

n2127b3382f7.s:
Consider the following pairs (Law Commission report – subject):
1. 14th Report – Reform of judicial administration
2. 59th Report – Gram Nyayalayas
3. 230th Report – 'Uncle judge' syndrome in High Courts
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
n2127b3382f7.x: Pairs 1 and 3 are correct. The 59th Report (1974) was on family courts; Gram Nyayalayas was the 114th.

na75c9e64ffe.s: Which of the following committee – subject pairs is correctly matched?
na75c9e64ffe.x: Ashok Dalwai dealt with doubling farmers' income. Nachiket Mor was on financial inclusion, Shanta Kumar on FCI–PDS reform and Santhanam on prevention of corruption.

ndc43100d581.s: Who was identified as Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Scheduled Castes Commission in August 2026?
ndc43100d581.x: K.S. Jawahar was identified as Chairman of the AP State SC Commission in August 2026.

n07093099305.s: The All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) is conducted by:
n07093099305.x: AISHE is conducted by the Ministry of Education; its 2022–23 and 2023–24 reports were released together in July 2026.

nb9fc6cc89c1.s: The 20th G20 Summit (November 2025), the first held on African soil, took place at:
nb9fc6cc89c1.x: The 20th G20 Summit was held in Johannesburg, South Africa, in November 2025.

n22d7e188480.s: The International Solar Alliance, the first intergovernmental body headquartered in India, has its headquarters at:
n22d7e188480.x: The ISA is headquartered in Gurugram, the first intergovernmental body to have its HQ in India.

n96a8c3a3df6.s: Russia, admitted to the G8 in 1998, was suspended after the Crimea episode in:
n96a8c3a3df6.x: Russia joined in 1998 (creating the G8) and was suspended in 2014 after Crimea.

n2dd5e5cc89d.s: The 18th and last SAARC Summit, after which the organisation remains suspended, was held at:
n2dd5e5cc89d.x: The 18th and last SAARC Summit was held at Kathmandu in 2014; SAARC remains suspended.

n70379896026.s: Which of the following event – venue pairs is correctly matched?
o: Summit for a New Global Financing Pact – Paris
Summit for a New Global Financing Pact – Goa
n70379896026.x: The Summit for a New Global Financing Pact was in Paris; the MI-8 Ministerial was in Goa and the Global Pulse Confederation conclave in India.

nc575f858a05.s: Following its Davos 2026 commitment, Andhra Pradesh signed a Food Cluster MoU in July 2026 with:
nc575f858a05.x: The AP–UAE Food Cluster MoU of July 2026 followed the Davos 2026 commitment.

n8ef47e22610.s: Which is the only UN Climate Change COP that India has hosted?
n8ef47e22610.x: India has hosted only COP8, held in 2002.
